scope: Human approval gate on a proposed customer reply
purpose: Human approval gate on a proposed customer reply
trigger: A support request with a proposed reply

inputs.in_scope: Optional field (may be missing), named in local snapshot contract
inputs.proposed_reply: Optional field (may be missing), named in local snapshot contract
inputs.approval_decision: Optional field (may be missing), named in local snapshot contract

preconditions: Single ticket snapshot; declared input fields may be absent; counters/flags trusted
ordered_activities: Send only approved reply then route to Resolved by AI
actions: Send only approved reply then route to Resolved by AI
exceptions_and_escalation: See conditional activities; no external side effects
expected_outputs: Local ticket state and operation trace

forbidden_actions.reason: Local simulator has no authority to transfer money; vendor example mentions a refund notification only.

postconditions: Independent case assertions hold on supported fixtures

source_backed_requirements.description: Only valid-scope requests proceed to approval; approved reply is sent before resolution and rejection goes to Manual Review
source_backed_requirements.expected_evidence: Independent state/trace assertions across the named fixtures

simulation_assumptions: Human decision is supplied in approval_decision; request_approval consumes it once, with no real wait.
AI drafting is represented by copying proposed_reply. It is not measured LLM drafting.
Only approved/rejected decisions are supported; missing decision fails explicitly.
limitations: Full n8n graph unavailable; this is a derived approximation.
No actual email, Trello or guardrail classification.
